<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XVIII.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|51}}</noinclude>ones that beleeue in me, it is expedient for him that a milstone be hanged about his necke, and that he be drovvned in the depth of the sea.

{{verse|chapter=18|verse=7}}† VVo be to the vvorld for ‖ scandals. for it is necessary that scandals do come: but neuerthelesse vvo to that man by vvhom the scandall commeth. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=8}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 5, 30. Mar. 9, 43.''}}* if thy ‖ hand, or thy foote scandalize thee: cut it of, and cast it from thee. It is good for thee to goe in to life maimed or lame, rather then hauing tvvo hands or tvvo feete to be cast into euerlasting fire. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=9}}† And if thine eye scandalize thee, plucke him out, and cast him from thee: It is good for thee hauing one eye to enter into life, rather then hauing tvvo eyes to be cast into the hel of fire. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=10}}† See that you despise not one of these litle ones: for I say to you that ‖ their Angels, in heauen alvvaies do see the face of my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=11}}† For {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 19, 10.''}}* the Sonne of man is come to saue that vvhich vvas perished. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=12}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lu. 15, 4.''}}* Hovv thinke you? If a man haue an hundred sheepe, and one of them shal goe astray: doth he not leaue ninetie nine in the mountaines, and goeth to seeke that which is straied? {{verse|chapter=18|verse=13}}† And if it chaunce that he finde it: amen I say to you, that he reioyceth more fore that, then for the ninetie nine that vvent not astray. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=14}}† Euen so it is not the vvil of your father, vvhich is in heauen, that one perish of these litle ones.

{{verse|chapter=18|verse=15}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Tuesday the 3 weeke in Lent.}}But {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 17, 3.''}}* if thy brother shal offend against thee, goe, and rebuke him betvvene thee and him alone. If he shal heare thee, thou shalt gaine thy brother. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=16}}† And if he vvil not heare thee, ioyne vvith thee besides, one or tvvo: that in the mouth of {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 19, 15.''}}* tvvo or three vvitnesses euery vvord may stand. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=17}}† And if he vvil not heare them, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ That is (as S. Chrysostom here expoundeth it) tell the Prelates and cheefe Pastours of the Church: for they haue iurisdiction to binde and loose such offenders, by the wordes folowing v. 18.}}∷ tel the Church. ''And if he vvil ‖ not heare the Church, let him be to thee as ‖ the heathen and the Publican''. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=18}}† Amen I say to you, whatsoeuer ‖ you shal binde vpon earth, shal be bound also in heauen: and vvhatsoeuer you ‖ shal loose vpon earth, shal be loosed also in heauen. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=19}}† Againe I say to you, that if two of you shal {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Al ioyning together in the vnity of Christes Churche in Councels and Synods, or publike prayers, is of more force then of any particular man.}}∷ consent vpon earth, concerning euery thing vvhatsoeuer they shal aske, it shal be done to them of my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=20}}† For vvhere there be tvvo or three gathered in my name, there am I ‖ in the middes of them.

{{verse|chapter=18|verse=21}}† Then came Peter vnto him and said, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lu. 17, 4.''}}* Lord, how often shal my brother offend against me, and I forgiue him? vntil<noinclude>{{rh||G ij|seuentimes?}}</noinclude>
